purpose: Check whether the existing listing-short sleeve has observed exposure at the times an independently capitalized native NFI14 account needs diversification, and whether adding a separate listing universe would encounter a slot bottleneck.
reference: Reconciled 14-slot Binance perpetual native NFI accounts. For observed account timing comparisons use the 15 bp cost common to the A05 archive, keeping the original 3x NFI and separate original 1x A05 leverage. Never sum these independent equity curves into a combined account.
listing: Use checksum-verified A05 AllLaunches 15 bp archived paths for both the 2025-start continuous wallet and the separate 2026 cash reset. Preserve risk-halt and cash days. Classify positive listing exposure only when the auxiliary ledger actually holds at least one position.
timing: At the UTC peak and trough of the full native account and of the largest native drawdown inside each auxiliary account's covered dates, measure each curve at those endpoints. When either date is outside the observed auxiliary ledger, report the gap without splicing paths or imputing inactivity.
days: Mark daily from UTC midnight to midnight on full common days with actual auxiliary exposure. Count days when an auxiliary positive return coincides with a negative NFI daily return and within the deepest prior-era decile of those observed negative NFI days, defined by sorting that fixed day's return sample. This is descriptive, without simulated funding transfers.
capacity: For each of the 287 registered listing clocks under a separate listing universe, compare pre-candle native open positions with native accepted first fills and full closes, using both cost rates and 14 slots. Count guaranteed room only if pre-candle positions plus all same-candle native first fills are below 14. If pre-candle and post-candle positions both remain 14 the clock still does not guarantee admissibility. This estimates timing or existing slot availability only.
